name: Find and move by category
definition: Locate an object that belongs to a specified category (living thing, non-living thing, animal, or plant), focus on it, and move it to a specified colored box.

name: Test electrical conductivity
definition: Determine whether a substance or object is electrically conductive, then place it in the box corresponding to the result.

name: Measure thermal property and sort
definition: Use a thermometer to measure a specified thermal property (temperature or melting point) of a substance or object and compare it to a threshold, then place the object in or focus on the corresponding colored box as the task instructs.

name: Change state of matter
definition: Apply heating or cooling to a substance so that it changes its state of matter.

name: Power a light bulb with a circuit
definition: Build a closed electrical circuit, using the specified type of power source (renewable or nonrenewable) when required, to turn on a specified light bulb.

name: Create substance by chemistry
definition: Follow a recipe and use chemistry-related actions to create a specified substance or paint, focusing on any required intermediate and the final product.

name: Grow plant from seed
definition: Grow one or more plants from seed to the required life stage, cross-pollinating plants to produce fruit when the task requires fruit.

name: Compare animal life spans
definition: Identify the animal(s) with the longest, shortest, or both longest and shortest life span among the animals in an area and focus on it or them.

name: Order life stages
definition: Identify and focus on the developmental life stages of an organism in a specified order.
